description: Search Polymarket's open prediction markets by topic. Use short, neutral topic words, the way a market would be named: 'House 2026' or 'which party wins the House', not 'Republicans lose the House'; 'Fed rate cut', 'bitcoin November'. Results are the matching events ranked by total volume, busiest first (pass rank 'relevance' for Polymarket's own text order): the headline market on a topic is usually the busiest, so for 'the most traded market about X' the first result is the answer; if none of the results asks the question directly, search again with other words. For each event: its markets with the Yes odds in percent, the change over 24 hours and a week (in points), volume, liquidity, the date it closes (not the event's own date), status, and a link. Markets with a wide spread or little liquidity are marked thin. Read-only market prices from Polymarket's public API, not forecasts or advice. Use for 'what are the odds of...', 'will X happen?', 'what does Polymarket say about...'. Then prediction_market for one market's history: pass the market's `ref`.

include_closed.description: Also return resolved markets (for 'how did X resolve?'). Default false

rank.description: Order of the results: by volume (default) or Polymarket's text relevance

name: prediction_markets
title: Prediction market odds (Polymarket)
